svg.title: From sessions to a frozen detector
svg.desc: 7 steps from top to bottom: dev split: 1,000 legal and 100 searcher sessions (design on these as often as you like); features: 8 numbers for each session (from its inputs and rounds alone); score: one number, higher is more suspicious (your own rule and settings); threshold: at most 2 of the 1,000 legal scores at or above (chooseThreshold at budget 0.002); freeze: hash the settings and detector files (a later change shows in your receipt); held-out split, read once: 2,000 legal and 200 searcher (the frozen detector flags; count recall and false flags); precision when 1 session in 100 is a cheat (how many flags would be cheats). A bar beside the first four marks the steps that use the dev split.
